title: The Internet's Obsession Meter
subtitle: A daily attention race for celebrities, games, films, products, teams, and events that suddenly take over the web.

cityPreview.summary: Wikipedia attention spikes for mass-interest people, games, movies, products, teams, and events.

confidence: Observed daily English Wikipedia article pageviews through 2026-09-01.
methodology: This story is generated from the Wikimedia Pageviews API for selected high-interest English Wikipedia articles. Values are daily all-access, user-agent-filtered pageviews. The story publishes a render-ready projection and keeps raw API responses out of the public payload.
